order: Staff the five remaining evidence-band seats: Scout, Researcher, LC Analyst, Investigator, and Archivist. Ship six role files, since Archivist splits into two lane files — documents and images — rather than one file with two variants, because each lane is its own single casting with no mirror rung. The Scout file is renamed to avoid colliding with the existing top-level scout file already in the repository. It never ships under the plain name at all. Carry the Investigator's tool restriction to reads over from the alias it is built from, unchanged. For Researcher and LC Analyst, ship the primary launcher file for now and leave the mirror rung unshipped — but record that gap explicitly in the roster ledger rather than skip it silently. Update the roster README and its ledger entry to capture every naming and rung decision made here, and leave exercising and reviewing these seats for a later stage.
claims: Shipped six role files — scout, researcher, lc-analyst, investigator, archivist-documents, and archivist-images — plus updates to the roster README and its ledger entry, spanning 8 files, and every other file stayed out of it. The scout file is renamed to avoid a collision with the existing top-level file; investigator carries the read-only tool pin from its source alias unchanged; researcher and lc-analyst ship primary-only, with the missing mirror rung recorded as a gap in the roster ledger.
